title: Predicate category
description: JSON Schema for a small predicate category C: an object-set (predicate-set Π = Ob(C)) together with four morphism tables, one per canonical generator class. Each table lists morphisms as (source, target) pairs in that class; composition is generated freely modulo the identities required by the class semantics, and is not stored. Composition closure, Sym(E)-equivariance, and the 'four classes exhaust bottom-preserving bilattice homomorphisms' theorem from code/structures/predicate-category.md must be checked by a verifier.

objects.description: The predicate-set Π = Ob(C). References the predicate-set schema by inline structural copy.

specialization.description: Specialization morphisms — pairs (source, target) meaning the morphism refines source to the more-specific target.

converse.description: Converse morphisms — pairs (source, target) such that the morphism takes the (s p o) interpretation of source to the (o p s) interpretation of target. Converse is an involution: applying twice returns to source.

subject-projection.description: Subject-projection morphisms — pairs (source, target) such that the morphism collapses cells of source along the diagonal (s, o) ↦ (s, s), yielding a unary predicate target depending only on the subject coordinate.

object-projection.description: Object-projection morphisms — pairs (source, target) such that the morphism collapses cells of source along the diagonal (s, o) ↦ (o, o), yielding a unary predicate target depending only on the object coordinate.
